<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>roadFeatures</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-roadfeatures" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">RoadFeatures</a>&gt; roadFeatures</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Features which routes should avoid. Best effort only (not enforced).</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="countries">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>countries</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-countrycode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.core">CountryCode</a>&gt; countries</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Countries that the route must avoid. Strictly enforced.
 Violations are reported as <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sectionnoticecode#VIOLATED_BLOCKED_ROAD"><code>SectionNoticeCode.VIOLATED_BLOCKED_ROAD</code></a>.
 <strong>Note:</strong> This avoidance option is not supported in <code>IsolineOptions</code> for isoline calculation.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="avoidBoundingBoxAreasOptions">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>avoidBoundingBoxAreasOptions</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-avoidboundingboxareaoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing">AvoidBoundingBoxAreaOptions</a>&gt; avoidBoundingBoxAreasOptions</pre>
<div class="block"><p>List of rectangular shapes which routes must not cross and additional options for this area.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="avoidPolygonAreasOptions">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>avoidPolygonAreasOptions</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-avoidpolygonareaoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing">AvoidPolygonAreaOptions</a>&gt; avoidPolygonAreasOptions</pre>
<div class="block"><p>List of polygon shapes which routes must not cross and additional options for this area.
 <strong>Note:</strong> Currently, the maximum count of polygons is limited to 20.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="avoidCorridorAreasOptions">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>avoidCorridorAreasOptions</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-avoidcorridorareaoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing">AvoidCorridorAreaOptions</a>&gt; avoidCorridorAreasOptions</pre>
<div class="block"><p>List of corridor shapes which routes must not cross and additional options for this area.
 <strong>Note:</strong> Currently, the maximum count of corridors is limited to 20.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="zoneCategories">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>zoneCategories</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-zonecategory" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">ZoneCategory</a>&gt; zoneCategories</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Zone categories which routes must not cross. Strictly enforced.
 Violations are reported as <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sectionnoticecode#VIOLATED_ZONE_RESTRICTION"><code>SectionNoticeCode.VIOLATED_ZONE_RESTRICTION</code></a>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="segments">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>segments</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-segmentreference" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing">SegmentReference</a>&gt; segments</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Segments that routes will avoid going through.
 Violations are reported as <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sectionnoticecode#VIOLATED_BLOCKED_ROAD"><code>SectionNoticeCode.VIOLATED_BLOCKED_ROAD</code></a>.
 <p><strong>Notes:</strong>
 <ul>
 <li>This avoidance option is not supported in <code>IsolineOptions</code> for isoline calculation.</li>
 <li>The engine does not support an unlimited number of segments to avoid.
 The limit is defined by the HERE backend services and may change. For now,
 the maximum number of segments to avoid should be below 250. This value may change
 on the backend and it is therefore not guaranteed to be stable.</li>
 </ul></div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="exceptZoneIds">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>exceptZoneIds</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;java.lang.String&gt; exceptZoneIds</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Exception to <code>AvoidanceOptions.zone_categories</code>, which can be specified by list of zone identifiers.
 e.g. the format of ID is like <code>here:cm:envzone:2</code>.
 Information about the various routing zones originates from the respective catalogs of platform.here.com.
 For example, more information on zone IDs for Environmental Zones is available under &quot;https://platform.here.com/data/hrn:here:data::olp-here:rib-2/environmental-zones/overview&quot;.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="zoneIds">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>zoneIds</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;java.lang.String&gt; zoneIds</pre>
<div class="block"><p>List containing identifiers of zones that routes should avoid going through.
 e.g. the format of ID is like <code>here:cm:envzone:2</code>.
 Information about the various routing zones originates from the respective catalogs of platform.here.com.
 For example, more information on zone IDs for Environmental Zones is available under &quot;https://platform.here.com/data/hrn:here:data::olp-here:rib-2/environmental-zones/overview&quot;.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="avoidedTruckRoadTypes">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>avoidedTruckRoadTypes</h4>

public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-truckroadtype" title="enum in com.here.sdk.transport">TruckRoadType</a>&gt; avoidedTruckRoadTypes</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Specifies a list of avoided truck road types for vehicle.
 Refer to <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-truckroadtype" title="enum in com.here.sdk.transport"><code>TruckRoadType</code></a> for the available options.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
